decisions.rationale: 6 days post-signup with no reply to the welcome note (email:ae250b96), no project, no invite, no tickets, no engagement signal of any kind. Starter plan, 8 days left. Fully silent accounts rarely self-activate without a nudge.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting Union Studio's first project up
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Checking in since your Wrenfield workspace went live last week. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
